honesty_note: RUL labels are the TRUE remaining life ((n_files-1-i)*10s) on complete run-to-failure bearings, NOT the positional stage proxy. In-distribution (same-bearing, exchangeable) the conformal interval holds its target coverage; cross-bearing it under-covers because absolute time-to-failure does not transfer to a never-seen bearing — the interval is honest about that (it would need per-asset calibration / online updating to recover).
